Compute the mean:
\[
\bar x=\frac{1+12-17-3-11-5}{6}=\frac{-23}{6}.
\]
Sum of squared deviations:
\[
\sum (x_i-\bar x)^2=\left(\frac{29}{6}\right)^2+\left(\frac{95}{6}\right)^2+\left(\frac{-79}{6}\right)^2+\left(\frac{5}{6}\right)^2+\left(\frac{-43}{6}\right)^2+\left(\frac{-7}{6}\right)^2
=\frac{18030}{36}=\frac{3005}{6}.
\]
Sample variance (divide by \(n-1=5\)):
\[
s^2=\frac{1}{5}\cdot \frac{3005}{6}=\frac{601}{6}.
\]
So the sample standard deviation is
\[
s=\sqrt{\frac{601}{6}}=\frac{\sqrt{3606}}{6}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\sqrt{\frac{601}{6}}}
\]
